post.summary: Issue an invitation to an address in a tenant
post.description: Normalizes the address (trimmed, lower-cased printable ASCII with exactly one @, at most 254 bytes), then issues a pending invitation. A pending invitation for the same tenant and address is superseded in the same transaction, so its token stops working. expires_at is optional: when absent, the zero instant or the configured lifetime applies (168 hours by default), and a deadline not later than the current time is refused. Requires the authn.membership.manage decision in the tenant; failure to write the mandatory audit row answers 503 without issuing.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The string form of the tenant identifier the invitation belongs to; the authn.membership.manage decision is made in this tenant.

requestBody.description: The address to invite and an optional absolute deadline. Only email is required.

schema.description: The issue request: the invited address, which is normalized before it is stored, and an optional deadline.

email.description: The invited address as given; it is trimmed, lower-cased and must be printable ASCII with exactly one @, at most 254 bytes.

expires_at.description: Absolute deadline in RFC 3339. Omitted or the zero instant takes the configured lifetime; a value not later than the current time is refused with 400.

201.description: The invitation view together with its one-time token

400.description: The body could not be read, or the address is malformed

403.description: The caller may not manage memberships in the tenant

get.summary: One page of a tenant's invitations
get.description: Returns one page of the tenant's invitations, ordered by status ascending (pending, accepted, revoked) and then by creation time descending with the identifier as the tie-break. The cursor is opaque: pass the previous page's next_cursor as after to resume, and an unreadable cursor is refused with 400 rather than served as the first page. Expired pending invitations are still listed with status pending. A read writes no audit row.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The string form of the tenant identifier the invitation belongs to; the authn.membership.manage decision is made in this tenant.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of invitations to return. Omitted or 0 serves 100; a value above 1000 is capped at 1000. A negative or non-integer value is refused with 400.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's next_cursor; omit it to start at the first page. A value that does not decode is refused with 400 rather than served as the first page.

200.description: The page of invitations and the next cursor

400.description: The page query could not be read

403.description: The caller may not manage memberships in the tenant

delete.description: Revokes a pending invitation and voids its token; the invitation identifier also serves as the decision's target. Revoking an already revoked invitation succeeds idempotently, while revoking an accepted one answers 409 because removing a membership is not this route's job. Failure to write the mandatory audit row answers 503 without revoking.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The string form of the tenant identifier the invitation belongs to; the authn.membership.manage decision is made in this tenant.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The invitation's opaque identifier, which also serves as the decision's target.

403.description: The caller may not manage memberships in the tenant

get.summary: Read the invitation a token points to
get.description: Resolves the token's SHA-256 to an invitation and returns its view so a client can show what it is about to accept. The route is public and the token is the whole credential; the response never carries a token. An unknown token is 404. The view reflects the stored state even when the invitation can no longer be accepted, so the client should read status and expires_at rather than assume the link is redeemable.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The acceptance token, prefixed spd_inv_, which identifies the invitation and is the whole credential on this public route.

409.description: The invitation is expired, revoked or already accepted

post.summary: Redeem an invitation, creating the account when the address has none
post.description: Redeems the invitation and writes a membership whose source is invite. When the invited address already belongs to an account, the membership is added to it and display_name and password are ignored; otherwise an enabled user account is created first, with the address verified through the invitation. Two concurrent redemptions of one token leave at most one winner. A token that is expired, revoked or already accepted is 409.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The acceptance token, prefixed spd_inv_, which identifies the invitation and is the whole credential on this public route.

requestBody.description: The display name and initial password used only when the invited address has no account yet.

schema.description: The acceptance request; both fields are read only when the invited address has no account.

display_name.description: Display name of the account created when the invited address has no account; ignored when the address already belongs to one.

password.description: Initial password of the account created when the invited address has no account; ignored when the address already belongs to one.

400.description: The body or an argument is malformed

409.description: The invitation is expired, revoked or already accepted

AuthnInviteInvitation.description: One invitation as the management face shows it. It never carries the acceptance token.

id.description: The invitation's opaque identifier, used to revoke it.

tenant.description: The string form of the tenant identifier the invitation grants a membership in.

status.description: The stored state. Expiry is not stored: an expired pending invitation still reads pending.

invited_by.description: The account identifier of the issuer; empty when a host command issued the invitation without an HTTP identity.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 deadline in UTC; a pending invitation at or past it can no longer be accepted.

accepted_at.description: The zero instant 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when the invitation has not been accepted

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC of issuance.

AuthnInviteIssued.description: The answer of an issue: the invitation's view together with its one-time acceptance token.

invitation.description: The issued invitation; the token is delivered beside it, not inside it.

token.description: The acceptance token, handed out once

AuthnInviteView.description: The answer of the acceptance read: the invitation a token points to.

invitation.description: The invitation the token points to, without its token.

AuthnInvitePage.description: One page of a tenant's invitations together with the cursor of the next page.

invitations.description: The invitations of this page, ordered by status ascending (pending, accepted, revoked) and then newest first with the identifier as the tie-break.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page, empty on the last page

account.description: Identifier of the account the membership belongs to: an existing account or one created by this acceptance.

tenant.description: The string form of the tenant identifier the membership was written in.

active.description: Whether the membership is active; an acceptance always writes an active one.

source.description: The membership's source; an acceptance always writes invite.

sso_exempt.description: Whether the membership is exempt from SSO enforcement; an acceptance writes false.
